com.addr.hunterj.jdbc
Interface JdbcResourceMonitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultResourceMonitor
public interface JdbcResourceMonitor

JdbcResourceMonitor provides a mechanism by which the default behavior, regarding the creation java.sql.Statement and java.sql.ResultSet objects within a JdbcQueryHandler. The default behavior is to allow only one Statement and one ResultSet per JdbcQueryHandler so that these resources can be closed immediately after execution of JdbcQueryHandler.doQueryAndProcessResults(). This behavior is enforced with the DefaultResourceMonitor implementation. Although it is not recommended, the default behavior can be overridden with a new JdbcResourceMonitor implementation provided to JdbcQueryManager.setResourceMonitor(JdbcResourceMonitor).
